session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trap, Endless Pullback, Bear Trend Day' (axis 08:55-15:00). Big-bar bull trap at the open (big bar so big risk, not ideal stop entry), breakout below the bull flag with the sell-the-close leg in the small pullback bear trend, the parabolic wedge at 3842 with the 20 gap bar sell, endless pullback after the parabolic wedge top in the tight channel, and the late sell the close into the 3812 low.
